meta.notes: Barnes: one record per Item # from the public product pages; values from the page's embedded spec sheet ("specsJson", shown in the Specs tab) cross-checked against the page's "customFields" copy and the product name; any disagreement -> conflicts and the field is null. Evidence quotes the decoded specsJson block of the item verbatim (whitespace collapsed) plus the customFields values. Barnes "Minimum Twist Rate" is given in inches per turn. Construction mapped from the Barnes "Bullet Material" category: 100% Copper -> monolithic-copper, Solid Brass -> monolithic-brass, Jacketed Lead Core -> cup-and-core, Jacketed Non-Lead -> null. The Barnes 2026 catalog exists only as a raster poster (no bullet lengths) and was not parsed. Speer: product pages (only source with "Bullet Length In") cross-checked with the Speer 2026 catalog PDF tables (pages 16-25) by Part #; disagreements -> conflicts and null. Catalog rows without a product page are kept as catalog-only records (no length). Speer "BC" columns do not name the drag model except the Impact table (G1/G7); they are stored as bcG1 with a bcNotes remark. Lead round balls, plastic training bullets and shot capsules are excluded. No value was typed in or estimated; boatTailLengthIn and baseToOgiveIn are not published by either maker.

bullets.notes: Barnes "Bullet Material" category: 100% Copper | Product Details: The TAC-TX bullet is a special purpose expanding all-copper bullet that is optimized around AR platforms. AR's feature shorter carbine length barrels which reduce the muzzle velocity when compared to a standard barrel length. To achieve the same terminal performance that Barnes fans are used to, we added a larger tip to allow more fluid to enter the nose and modified the bullet cavity to maximize expansion at lower velocities. These bullets track straighter through barriers and have better weight retention than lead-core bullets. New for 2026- The .224" 22 CAL 70gr TAC-TX BT was designed and optimized around the 22 ARC and its velocity range. The cannelure is correctly positioned so you can crimp into it. Being a sleek 70gr copper projectile, you need a 1:7 twist rate or faster to stabilize it. The 22 Creedmoor is another great application for this bullet, however, make sure you have a fast enough twist rate. The SAAMI standard for a 22 Creedmoor is slower- 1:8 twist. The nose length is .702 which makes it too long to mag feed a 223 Rem or similar cartridge. | Purpose: Hunting; Pursuit: Medium Game | Box quantity 50 | Box UPC 716876224623 | Printed sectional density 0.199 | listed in the Barnes "2026 New Products" category

bullets.notes: Barnes "Bullet Material" category: 100% Copper | Product Details: The TAC-TX bullet is a special purpose expanding all-copper bullet that is optimized around AR platforms. AR's feature shorter carbine length barrels which reduce the muzzle velocity when compared to a standard barrel length. To achieve the same terminal performance that Barnes fans are used to, we added a larger tip to allow more fluid to enter the nose and modified the bullet cavity to maximize expansion at lower velocities. These bullets track straighter through barriers and have better weight retention than lead-core bullets. New for 2026- The .243" 6mm 90gr TAC-TX BT was designed and optimized around the 6mm ARC and its velocity range. We offer other .243" 6mm TTSX & TSX bullets that may shoot well in a 6mm ARC, but their internal cavities were designed for higher velocity cartridges and will not provide sufficient terminal performance in this cartridge or similar cartridges. The cannelure is correctly positioned so you can crimp into it. In addition to the 6mm ARC, the 6mm Creedmoor is also a great application for this bullet. | Purpose: Hunting; Pursuit: Big Game, Medium Game | Box quantity 50 | Box UPC 716876243907 | Printed sectional density 0.218 | listed in the Barnes "2026 New Products" category

bullets.notes: Barnes "Bullet Material" category: 100% Copper | Product Details: The TAC-TX bullet is a special purpose expanding all-copper bullet that is optimized around AR platforms. AR's feature shorter carbine length barrels which reduce the muzzle velocity when compared to a standard barrel length. To achieve the same terminal performance that Barnes fans are used to, we added a larger tip to allow more fluid to enter the nose and modified the bullet cavity to maximize expansion at lower velocities. These bullets track straighter through barriers and have better weight retention than lead-core bullets. The .308" 300 ACC BLK TAC-TX 110 GR FB was designed and optimized around the 300 AAC BLK and its velocity range. We offer other 30 Cal TTSX & TSX bullets that may shoot well in the 300 AAC BLK, but their internal cavities were designed for higher velocity cartridges and will not provide sufficient terminal performance in this cartridge or similar cartridges. The cannelure is correctly positioned so you can crimp into it.
